===== BEGIN H38_design.txt =====
H38 kF search.cpp2095-2118 quiet_history changes eager perply mask read into threat_set_for_piece. Original r15d1606-1625 opened. One use per reached HistRework enabled/non-null stack mask read; actual read once, compare full mask with freshly computed original unconditional pawn/minor/rook threat unions. No lesser_threats call/H71 hook, no extra table write or actual history mutation. This is distinct from H39 rework_entry consumer. Fullmask equality implies from/to history-index equality; White private bit0 fault always changes compared mask but need not change chosen endpoints.
Class partitions: White/Black; pawn_minor/rook/queen/king_empty; entryready/unready. Entrystate does not prove actual cached path used because pawn/minor may bypass map. Shared Board and attack primitives, not independent absolute legality/history-score proof. H47 production fastquiet direct reads remain outside H38; new constructor H24 only separately tests binding, not every later read.
Forecast informed prior Job27 B1 legalquiet returns S1 9079813,S2 3212417,S3 15424427, proxy for mainsearch quiet_history calls, not exact counts; extra TT/killers/evasion callers possible. No new counted probe.

===== END H38_design.txt =====

===== BEGIN H24_design.txt =====
H24 original r15d QuietScorer constructor bound the already eager threat-map slot; current constructor calls ensure_threat_map. One use per enabled constructor binding (HistRework nonzero and nonnull stack). Diagnostic ready-before member is declared AND initialized before the actual threats pointer initializer, so it samples pre-ensure state. Actual ensure executes once, unchanged. Body compares pointer identity to intended ply slot and post readiness1, plus map content against fresh old unconditional pawn/minor/rook attack unions without calling counted H71 helper.
Pawn/Knight/Bishop masks and zero King/NoPieceType always compared. Rook/Queen masks compared only when friendly consuming piece type exists: optimized absent-heavy fields intentionally omitted, not claimed bitwise equal. Wrong19 flips only private expected pawn union bit0 on White, affecting always-compared fields; private higher unions computed beforehand, no actual state changed.
White/Black, pre-ready/unready, and friendly-heavy neither/rook-only/queen-only/both partition uses. Disabled or no-stack construction is separately skipped, not counted as match. Production QuietScorer only; diagnostic QuietReferenceScorer untouched. Reference shares Board/attack helpers and same inputs, so not independent attack legality proof.
Constructor-bound snapshot checks capture initialized cache state even if a later direct fast-quiet path would read it, but this DOES NOT prove those later reads, invalidation/lifetime, every consumer, or fill the documented H47 unhooked fastquiet gap. Other constructor fields/continuation/history weights are outside H24. Existing old33 counters and full canonical final-info except time/nps must remain unchanged.
Prior-only forecast basis: one QuietScorer per H28 quiet-generation call plus zero-or-one per legal-evasion generation with at least2nonTT moves. Prior H29-H30 counts bound eligible evasion constructions. S1 H28=1376393,H29-H30=1820782;S2 493901+460274;S3 2410075+2215061. Declared bands1.3m..3.3m,.45m..1.1m,2.3m..4.9m informed by those previous runs, not fresh counted samples.

===== END H24_design.txt =====

===== BEGIN H24_cross_review.txt =====
Readonly cross-review PASS before freeze. Opened original r15d QuietScorer constructor904-928 and current staging production QuietScorer. New pre-ready member declared/initialized before actual threats binding, ensure called once. Reference original unconditional attack unions, expected pointer and ready==1, only present-heavy masks checked; absent-heavy payload intentionally unobservable. Disabled/no-stack exclusive skip bins. White private pawnmask XOR changes compared Pawn/Knight/Bishop expected values, no actual state/oldhook. Shares Board/attacks; constructor snapshot not later pointer lifetime or every direct H47fastquiet read. Diagnostic QuietReferenceScorer remains untouched.

===== END H24_cross_review.txt =====
